about: GTA 5's Los Santos is based on Los Angeles (Delta, pillar 5, real-world crossover). Rockstar North: GTA V is set in 'a re-imagined, present day Southern California', in 'the city of Los Santos'. Aaron Garbut (Rockstar North art director) to BuzzFeed, Aug 13 2013: 'We have a world that incorporates all of Los Angeles'; 'We've shot over 250,000 images and hours of video.' Edge (GamesRadar+, Sept 21 2015): 'Hollywood and its signage transmogrify into Vinewood'; 'Del Perro pier (a lovingly rendered homage to Santa Monica's pier)'; 'Santos' means 'Saints', a play against the 'Angels' of Los Angeles; 'The city isn't an exact recreation of Los Angeles'. Garbut to Edge, Jan 2 2014: real cities are 'a starting point'. Sources in BRIEF.md.
